# bitbucket_deployment_environment (Resource)

A Bitbucket Pipelines deployment environment (e.g. Staging, Production) on a repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bitbucket_deployment_environment" "production" {
  repository_slug  = bitbucket_repository.api.slug
  name             = "production"
  environment_type = "Production"
  admin_only       = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_type` (String) One of "Test", "Staging" or "Production". Cannot be changed after creation.
- `name` (String) Environment display name.
- `repository_slug` (String) Slug of the repository this environment belongs to.

### Optional

- `admin_only` (Boolean) Restrict deployments to this environment to workspace admins.

### Read-Only

- `environment_uuid` (String) Bitbucket-assigned UUID of the environment.
- `id` (String) Identifier, formatted as "workspace/repository_slug/environment_uuid".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bitbucket_deployment_environment.production payments-api/{environment-uuid}
```
